corrections.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.increment_question_views(question_id uuid)
RETURNS void
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public
AS $$
BEGIN
    UPDATE blog_questions 
    SET views = views + 1 
    WHERE id = question_id;
END;
$$;
